text:
Mia Chen: quick sync — we need a fast pass for the site hero and three short launch posts for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. also: webinar blurb + inbound routing mapping. can we do a 30m review today? :calendar:
Jordan Lee: i'm around 2pm PT, works for me. can we get one strong hero line and 2 CTA variants per page before review?
Samir Patel: i can draft hero lines. thinking: Hosted = "Ship LLM features fast." Dedicated = "Predictable throughput, dedicated GPUs." Private = "Inference in your VPC or on-prem." short and simple.
Tara Gomez: those are nice starts. Hosted needs a line about latency/cost tradeoffs. maybe: "Low-latency, usage-friendlier pricing for production apps."
Oliver Park: for copy hierarchy i suggest: hero, 1-sentence subhead, 3 bullets (performance, cost, reliability), CTA. that maps cleanly to the marketing pages.
Mia Chen: love that. can we get micro-post ideas too — 1) benchmark tease, 2) webinar invite, 3) customer story CTA. short social copy (280 chars).
Samir Patel: drafting micro-posts now. Quick drafts:
- Hosted benchmark: "Our Hosted API hits 99th percentile latency under Xms on real-world chat workloads. Want the details? Join the webinar. #inference #Latency"
- Dedicated post: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput — ideal for high-volume apps. See the math in our benchmarks."
- Private blurb: "Keep inference inside your network with Redwood Private — compliance-first, performance-minded. Webinar seats open."
Jordan Lee: sounds good. Add a short CTA URL param for tracking: ?utm_campaign=tri_launch&utm_source=post
Tara Gomez: for the webinar blurb i recommend: 45-minute session, product demo + 15m Q&A, highlight migration path from hosted→dedicated→private. date options: Apr 14 or Apr 21.
Mia Chen: let's pick Apr 21 to give eng time for the demo. Draft webinar headline?
Oliver Park: "Designing predictable inference at scale: cost, latency, and rollout patterns" simple.
Samir Patel: I'll write a 2-sentence description for the landing and one-line for the social.
Jordan Lee: inbound routing — how do we tag leads from each page and webinar? We should map to SDR routing and product-tier buckets.
Mia Chen: proposed mapping (keeps it small):
```
source:site_hosted => tag:interest:hosted, route:marketing_inbound
source:site_dedicated => tag:interest:dedicated, route:ae_dedicated_queue
source:site_private => tag:interest:private, route:security_sales_queue
source:webinar_signup => tag:engagement:webinar_launch, route:marketing_followup
```
Samir Patel: that mapping looks good. add a field for intent score >= 70 to route to AE immediately.
Tara Gomez: can we include an automated nurture email for webinar no-shows that links back to hosted/dedicated/private pages? short template please.
Mia Chen: draft nurture copy: "Missed the webinar? Catch the recording and explore a tailored guide for Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments. Tell us your size and we'll recommend next steps."
Jordan Lee: small ask — for the site bullets, include a micro line on SLOs / SLAs for Dedicated, and a short note about KMS/HSM for Private. compliance language must be precise: "integrates with customer KMS" not "supports KMS".
Oliver Park: noted. i'll update the copy doc with exact phrasing.
Samir Patel: putting together the copy doc now — hero lines + subheads + bullets + CTA variants + 3 micro-posts + webinar blurb + routing mapping. will share a gdoc in 10m.
Deploy Bot: link shared: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketing/tri-deploy-copy-draft (access: marketing only) :link:
Tara Gomez: thanks. i'll review and send copy edits inline.
Mia Chen: perfect. action items: Samir to post first draft (in 10m), Jordan to confirm tracking params, Oliver to add compliance lines for Private, Tara to finalize webinar logistics, Mia to run review at 2pm PT.
Jordan Lee: confirmed. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: draft uploaded. ping me if you want alternate CTAs.
Mia Chen: closing loop — 2pm review is on my calendar. see you then. :rocket:
